howItWorks.title: Luxury in Minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: No tools. No drilling. Just pure indulgence.

step1.title: Twist Tension Bar Into Place
step1.description: Extend the tension bar between your shower walls (works with spaces 56-80 inches wide) and twist until firmly secured. No drilling required.

step2.title: Close Safety Sheaths
step2.description: Slide the safety sheaths into position to lock the system securely in place. This ensures everything stays stable during use.

step3.title: Connect Shower Hose
step3.description: Attach the hose to your existing plumbing—hand tight, no tools needed. Turn on the water and start enjoying your new luxury rainfall shower.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Rainföll luxury rainfall shower systems.

installTime.a: Most customers complete installation in under 10 minutes. The process involves three simple steps: twist tension bar into place, close safety sheaths, and connect shower hose. No tools or drilling required.

toolsNeeded.q: Do I need any tools for installation?
toolsNeeded.a: No tools required! The Rainföll system uses a tension-based design that requires no drilling, screws, or special tools. Everything you need is included in box.

renterFriendly.q: Can I install it if I rent my apartment?
renterFriendly.a: Absolutely! Rainföll is perfect for renters because it requires no drilling or permanent modifications. When you move out, you can easily remove it without leaving any trace.

showerSizes.a: Rainföll works in showers with opposing walls 56-80 inches apart. This covers most standard shower sizes. The tension bar is adjustable to ensure a perfect fit.

plumbing.q: Does it work with my existing plumbing?
plumbing.a: Yes! Rainföll connects to your existing shower plumbing with standard fittings. The included hose attaches to your current shower arm or diverter valve.

finishes.a: Rainföll is available in four premium finishes: Chrome, Matte Black, Gold, and Rose Gold. Each finish is carefully selected to complement modern bathroom designs.

dualHeads.q: Can both shower heads be used simultaneously?
dualHeads.a: Yes! Both shower heads maintain full pressure when used simultaneously. There's no diverter valve that compromises water flow—both heads deliver powerful, luxurious water flow at once.

whatsIncluded.a: Each Rainföll system includes: tension bar, two rainfall shower heads, safety sheaths, connecting hoses, and all necessary fittings. Everything you need for installation is included.

cleaning.q: How do I clean the shower heads?
cleaning.a: Simply wipe the shower heads with a soft cloth and mild soap. For mineral buildup, soak the nozzles in a solution of equal parts white vinegar and water for 30 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.

warranty.a: Rainföll comes with a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects and workmanship. Extended warranty options are available at checkout.
